blockingIssues.description: The feature proves downgrade-on-unresolved-image and atlas reuse for cached text, but it does not complete a production image-binding path. `GPUISceneBridge` still emits bridged images with `textureID: -1`, `D3D11BatchRenderer.bindImageResource` is only used in tests, and `WinSwiftUIWindowHost` submits scenes without binding image resources first, so real image primitives still downgrade instead of batch-rendering successfully.
